responsibility: Generates the AVR manual’s `-mmcu=` documentation from the same MCU database used by the backend and driver tools. It groups and sorts recognized device names into human-friendly architecture sections, emits the texinfo table entries for each AVR core using `avr_texinfo`, lists the associated MCU names in lookup-friendly order, and sanity-checks for duplicate device definitions, so its output is the maintained documentation view of supported AVR architectures and device names rather than compiler logic itself.
